tools.name: create
tools.description: CREATE a new record with optional content data. Data is bound as a typed variable.

data.description:
JSON data for the record content. Bound as $data variable.
Use `{"$ql": "<surrealql expr>"}` anywhere in the tree to embed a
typed SurrealDB value (decimal, datetime, duration, record id,
uuid, ...) -- e.g. `{"price": {"$ql": "9.99dec"}, "customer":
{"$ql": "customer:alice"}}`.

target.description: Target table or record ID (e.g. "person" or "person:john").

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DELETE records with an optional WHERE clause. `where_clause` is a SurrealQL expression fragment -- use the `query` tool with $param bindings for dynamic values.

target.description: Target table or record to delete.

where_clause.description:
Optional `WHERE` clause (SurrealQL expression fragment). For dynamic
values use `$param` bindings via the raw `query` tool.

tools.name: gql
tools.description: Execute a GQL (ISO/IEC 39075) query with optional parameter bindings, e.g. `MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.name AS name`. GQL is an experimental capability that must be enabled on the server (`--allow-experimental gql`); otherwise the call returns a capability error.

parameters.description:
Optional JSON object of parameter bindings (e.g. {"name": "John"}).
Values are bound with their native types -- numbers stay numbers,
objects stay objects. Use `{"$ql": "<surrealql expr>"}` to embed typed
SurrealDB values such as decimals, datetimes, durations, record ids, or
uuids.

query.description:
The GQL (ISO/IEC 39075) query to execute, e.g.
`MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name`.

tools.name: graphql
tools.description: Execute a GraphQL query or mutation against the active namespace and database. The database must have a `DEFINE CONFIG GRAPHQL` statement. Provide GraphQL variables as a JSON object; returns the GraphQL `{ data, errors }` response envelope (GraphQL execution errors appear in `errors`, not as a tool error).

operation.description:
Optional operation name, used to select an operation when the document
defines more than one named operation.

query.description:
The GraphQL document to execute (a query or mutation operation).
Subscriptions, which require a streaming transport, are not supported
through this tool.

variables.description: Optional JSON object of GraphQL variables (e.g. {"id": "person:tobie"}).

tools.name: info
tools.description: Dump full schema information for a scope. Target: 'root', 'ns', 'db', or a table name. Defaults to the most specific current context. Use `list` when you only need entities of one kind.

target.description: Scope: "root", "ns", "db", or a table name. Defaults to most specific context.

tools.name: insert
tools.description: INSERT records into a table. Data is bound as a typed variable. Supports IGNORE and RELATION flags.

data.description:
JSON array of objects or single object to insert. Bound as $data
variable. Use `{"$ql": "<surrealql expr>"}` anywhere in the tree
to embed a typed SurrealDB value (decimal, datetime, duration,
record id, uuid, ...).

ignore.description: Whether to ignore duplicate key errors.

relation.description: Whether this is a relation insert.

target.description: Target table to insert into.

tools.name: list
tools.description: Enumerate schema entities of a single kind. `kind` is one of: namespaces, nodes, databases, tables, functions, analyzers, params, apis, buckets, models, modules, sequences, configs, users, accesses, fields, indexes, events. Set `table` for fields/indexes/events. Set `scope` (root|ns|db) for users/accesses.

scope.description: Required when `kind` is one of: users, accesses. One of: root, ns, db.

table.description: Required when `kind` is one of: fields, indexes, events.

ListKind.description: Kinds of schema entities that `list` can enumerate.

ListScope.description: Scope selector for kinds that exist at multiple levels.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a SurrealQL query with optional parameterized inputs. Use $param syntax for placeholders and provide bindings in the parameters object.

parameters.description:
Optional JSON object of parameter bindings (e.g. {"name": "John", "age": 30}).
Values are bound with their native types -- numbers stay numbers, objects stay objects.
Use `{"$ql": "<surrealql expr>"}` to embed typed SurrealDB values
such as decimals, datetimes, durations, record ids, or uuids
(e.g. `{"price": {"$ql": "9.99dec"}, "user": {"$ql": "person:alice"}}`).

query.description: The SurrealQL query to execute. Use $param syntax for parameter placeholders.

tools.name: relate
tools.description: RELATE records to create graph edges (from->table->to). Optional content is bound as a typed variable.

content_data.description:
Optional JSON content data for the edge record. Bound as $data.
Embed typed SurrealDB values via `{"$ql": "<expr>"}` (e.g.
`{"order": {"$ql": "order:o1"}, "quantity": 2}`).

tools.name: run
tools.description: Invoke a SurrealQL function (e.g. `math::sum`, `string::concat`, `fn::my_function`) with typed argument bindings. Arguments are bound natively; the function name is restricted to `identifier(::identifier)*`. Permissions and capabilities are enforced by SurrealDB.

args.description:
Optional argument list. Values are bound with their native types --
numbers stay numbers, objects stay objects. Embed typed SurrealDB
values via `{"$ql": "<expr>"}` -- e.g. pass a record id as
`{"$ql": "person:alice"}` or a decimal as `{"$ql": "9.99dec"}`.

tools.name: select
tools.description: SELECT records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. `fields`, `where_clause`, `order_clause`, `group_clause`, and `split_clause` are raw SurrealQL expression fragments -- use the `query` tool with $param bindings for dynamic values.

fetch_clause.description:
Optional `FETCH` clause: comma-separated SurrealQL expression
fragment naming record-link fields to hydrate (e.g.
`customer, items.*.product`). Use this to follow `record<...>`
references in one round-trip rather than issuing follow-up
queries.

fields.description:
Optional projection list (SurrealQL expression fragment; defaults
to `*`). For dynamic values use `$param` bindings via the raw
`query` tool.

order_clause.description:
Optional `ORDER BY` clause (SurrealQL expression fragment, e.g.
`name ASC`).

target.description:
Table or record target (e.g. "person", "person:john"). A single
identifier or record id; comma-separated multi-target selects are
not supported here -- use the raw `query` tool for those.

where_clause.description:
Optional `WHERE` clause as a SurrealQL expression fragment (e.g.
`age > 18`). For dynamic values use `$param` bindings via the raw
`query` tool.

tools.name: update
tools.description: UPDATE existing records with CONTENT, MERGE, or PATCH mode. Data is bound as a typed variable. `where_clause` is a SurrealQL expression fragment -- use the `query` tool with $param bindings for dynamic values.

content_data.description:
JSON data for CONTENT mode. Bound as $data. Embed typed
SurrealDB values via `{"$ql": "<expr>"}`.

merge_data.description:
JSON data for MERGE mode. Bound as $data. Same `$ql` escape
applies.

patch_data.description: JSON patch operations for PATCH mode. Bound as $data.

target.description: Target table or record (e.g. "person" or "person:john").

where_clause.description:
Optional `WHERE` clause (SurrealQL expression fragment). For dynamic
values use `$param` bindings via the raw `query` tool.

tools.name: upsert
tools.description: UPSERT records with CONTENT, MERGE, or PATCH mode. Data is bound as a typed variable. `where_clause` is a SurrealQL expression fragment -- use the `query` tool with $param bindings for dynamic values.

content_data.description:
JSON data for CONTENT mode (replaces entire record). Bound as
$data. Embed typed SurrealDB values via `{"$ql": "<expr>"}` (e.g.
`{"price": {"$ql": "9.99dec"}}`).

merge_data.description:
JSON data for MERGE mode (merges with existing). Bound as $data.
Same `$ql` escape applies for typed values.

patch_data.description: JSON patch operations for PATCH mode. Bound as $data.

target.description: Target table or record (e.g. "person" or "person:john").

where_clause.description:
Optional `WHERE` clause (SurrealQL expression fragment). For dynamic
values use `$param` bindings via the raw `query` tool.

tools.name: use
tools.description: Switch the active namespace and/or database. At least one of `namespace` or `database` must be provided; both can be set in a single call. Returns the resolved context.

database.description:
Database to switch to. If set without `namespace`, switches DB under
the current namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace to switch to. Either this or `database` must be set.

tools.description: Add a blocking relationship where this issue blocks another issue. The blocked issue cannot be closed until this issue is closed first.

blocked_index.description: Index of the issue that will be blocked by this issue

tools.name: add_issue_dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency relationship where this issue depends on another issue. The dependency must be closed before this issue can be closed.

dependency_index.description: Index of the issue this issue depends on

tools.name: add_issue_labels
tools.description: Add labels to an existing issue.

labels.description: Array of label IDs to add to this issue

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a repository. Specify title, body, and optional metadata like labels, assignees, milestone.

assignees.description: Array of usernames to assign to this issue (optional)

due_date.description: Issue due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z') (optional)

labels.description: Array of label IDs to assign to this issue (optional)

milestone.description: Milestone ID to assign to this issue (optional)

tools.name: create_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing issue.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new label in a repository. Specify the label name, description, and color.

color.description: Label color (hex color code without #, e.g., 'ff0000' for red)

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description: Create a new milestone in a repository. Specify the title, description, and optional due date.

due_date.description: Milestone due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z') (optional)

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in a repository. Provide the source and target branches, title, body, and optional metadata.

assignees.description: Additional usernames to assign to this pull request (optional)

due_date.description: Pull request due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z') (optional)

head.description: Source branch to merge from (optionally include owner as owner:branch)

labels.description: Array of label IDs to attach to this pull request (optional)

milestone.description: Milestone ID to associate with this pull request (optional)

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a new release in a repository. Specify tag name, title, description, and other metadata.

draft.description: Whether this is a draft release (optional, defaults to false)
